Changelog for version 1.1.0:

- Updated skill slug from `openclaw-install-workbuddy` to `openclaw-install-wsl-windows`.
- Added English/Chinese comments, author, contributor, and license details at the top of the guide.
- Rewrote and clarified many section headings and instructions with bilingual (English/Chinese) explanations throughout the guide.
- Improved formatting and step-by-step instructions for better readability.
- Updated download instructions for the WSL installer to indicate using the latest release from GitHub rather than a fixed version.

OpenClaw Install Guide (WSL2 Windows) v1.0.0

- Provides a complete step-by-step guide for installing OpenClaw on Windows 10/11 via WSL2.
- Covers both one-click (C drive) and custom (other drives) installation methods.
- Includes real-world troubleshooting tips, with solutions for common installation issues.
- Offers guidance on optimizing installations for users in Chinese network environments.
- Details essential pre-checks, environment configuration, and firewall settings to ensure smooth setup.
- Summarizes frequent pitfalls and their solutions based on actual installation experience.
